business: Abora Automation (sets up a missed-call SMS/WhatsApp reply and enquiry summaries for trade businesses)
by_segment: Established business, 6-15 employees, partner or office help does the phone
why_not: My wife takes the calls in the office and I ring people back in the evening, that has worked for twenty-odd years. We have more work than we can do already, so I don't see what 99 euros a month buys me.

My order book is full for months, so a missed call doesn't cost me anything. Whoever really needs us calls back or messages me on WhatsApp anyway, and I'm not paying 99 euros a month to collect even more requests I can't take on.

Two young founders with no customers yet who want to put themselves between my phone and my customers? I've had the same number for thirty years and my regulars call me, not a robot texting them back. Nobody I know uses it, so I'm not touching it.
